digest.component_or_area: source code comments and CI linting
propositions: Source code comments contain unresolvable commit SHAs, run/job IDs, and dated incident narratives that decay over time due to repository rebases and retention windows.
A detector must identify rot-prone tokens (hex >=7 chars, run IDs >=8 digits, dated incidents with past-tense verbs) and enforce remediation via CI guard integration.

Detected violations must be remediated by citing durable ticket IDs (hex-grouped or word-triple aliases), dropping rot-prone tokens while preserving current-state context, or replacing SHA narratives with behavioral descriptions.
The detector's own test module must be excluded from tree scans and contain live rot-prone fixtures to validate false-positive gotchas (e.g., 'bug surfaced' must not trigger).
An escape hatch for external vendor-pinned references must be documented; zero suppressions in the remediated tree except the structural detector exclusion.
